definitions.meaning: The pleasure of a vicious life(?), a life of pleasure

quotations.latin: lenocinii (antequam Samson illecebrosis lenocinii nexibus nodaretur, Ald. 72, 15)

source_text: hǽmed-dreám (?), -drím, -dríme(?), es; m. The pleasure of a vicious life(?), a life of pleasure :-- Hǽmedrímes (hǽmeddrímes), [hæmed-] scipes lenocinii (antequam Samson illecebrosis lenocinii nexibus nodaretur, Ald. 72, 15), An. Ox. 5046. (Cf. 5245, under hǽmed; I. )
